question:
Select the set of classes whose relationship between them is best represented by the given Venn diagram.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f836a0cd8aba2176a1c366bae703e7c4cbc414302ef2c1053d6ffd95cdf25ec.png]
solution:
The set of classes whose relationship between them is best represented by the given Venn diagram is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5479a0a81c605ee4506b8f229e937812ac3c09caf25be5978f3a23ded8431861.png] 

 
• All mothers are women.
 
• Some mothers and women are lawyers.

Hence, '**mothers, women, lawyers**' is the correct answer.
